inputs.value: Instrumental liquid drum and bass, arcade breakbeat at 132 BPM in D minor. An agile glass mallet lead and filtered clavinet trade syncopated notes over a fluid rubbery sub-bass. Brushed breakbeats, short kick and snare, bubbling stereo pulses, and wide sustained deep-sea chords. A clear melodic hook by the second bar, more active counterpoint in the B section, clean instrumental studio mix with space for game effects. No voice, choir or lyrics.
